knowledge_graph.title: Internal Revenue Service
knowledge_graph.description: The Internal Revenue Service is the revenue service for the United States federal government, which is responsible for collecting U.S. federal taxes and administering the Internal Revenue Code, the main body of the federal statutory tax law.
